1: # Walkthrough - Roles Hub Daily Lineup & Floor Plan Planner Redesign
2: 
3: Refactored the Roles Hub to feature a **Daily Lineup & Floor Plan Planner** as the primary view, replacing the massive, overwhelming weekly grid of 105 dropdowns. This makes managing daily operational shifts, employee absences, and station coverage highly visual and stress-free.
4: 
5: Also implemented backend fallback resolution and quick auto-fill actions.
6: 
7: ---
8: 
9: ## Changes Made
10: 
11: ### 📋 Database & Backend Fallback
12: - **Schedule Publisher Route** ([app/api/notifications/publish-schedule/route.ts](file:///c:/Users/pedro/Desktop/teg-modernizado/app/api/notifications/publish-schedule/route.ts)):
13:   - Implemented dynamic fallback resolution of activities from Toast job titles if no manual station assignment is configured for the day.
14:   - Added a robust store name checks fallback for Drive-Thru (`hasDT`) stores (`NORWALK`, `RIALTO`, `SANTA ANA`, etc.) to resolve correct activities even when `station_assignments` is empty.
15:   - Resolved fallback roles are displayed with a green/teal **"Rol"** badge in emails.
16: 
17: ### 🌐 Frontend (Daily Lineup & Floor Plan Board)
18: - **Primary Daily Lineup Interface** ([app/roles/page.tsx](file:///c:/Users/pedro/Desktop/teg-modernizado/app/roles/page.tsx)):
19:   - Added `viewMode` toggle state supporting both **Alineación Diaria (Daily Lineup)** (default) and **Grilla Semanal (Weekly Matrix)** views.
20:   - **Left Panel (Roster Today)**: Lists scheduled employees for the day/shift. Categorized as "Available", "Assigned", and "Absent". Enables 1-click station assignments.
21:   - **Right Panel (Station Cards)**: Renders each station as a beautiful visual card showing the assigned employee, their daily resolved activities checklist, or a "Vacante" selector showing uncovered activities.
22:   - **Shift Absence Toggle**: Integrated a sick/absent toggle directly in the roster. Clicking "Mark Absent" updates the shift's `is_callback` to `true` in the database, removes them from any assigned station, and moves them to "Absent" group.
23: - **Smart Actions & Automation**:
24:   - **Auto-fill Today / Week**: Automatically maps cooks to kitchen and cashiers to front stations based on Toast schedules.
25:   - **Copy to Tomorrow**: Copies the day's line-up to tomorrow with an **intelligence guard** (only transfers assignments if the employee is also scheduled to work tomorrow).
26:   - **Clear Today**: Wipes current day assignments to start fresh.
27: - **Bilingual Dictionary** ([lib/i18n.tsx](file:///c:/Users/pedro/Desktop/teg-modernizado/lib/i18n.tsx)):
28:   - Added bilingual keys for all new buttons, views, roster headers, and dialog confirmations.
